skills.name: memory_runtime
skills.description: Persistent memory runtime over IndexedDB chunks/documents.

tools.name: memory_ingest_url
tools.description: Store URL content in IndexedDB long-term retrieval memory (not guaranteed to be injected into every prompt).

tools.name: memory_ingest_text
tools.description: Store raw text in IndexedDB long-term retrieval memory (not guaranteed to be injected into every prompt).

tools.name: memory_query
tools.description: Query IndexedDB long-term retrieval memory on demand; results are not always part of base prompt context.

tools.name: memory_list_documents
tools.description: List IndexedDB long-term memory documents for the current scope.

tools.name: memory_get_document
tools.description: Read one IndexedDB long-term memory document and its chunks.

tools.name: memory_delete_document
tools.description: Delete one document from IndexedDB long-term memory.

tools.name: memory_clear
tools.description: Clear IndexedDB long-term memory for the active scope.

skills.name: heartbeat_runtime
skills.description: Heartbeat checklist and pending-item runtime tools.

tools.name: heartbeat_add_pending_item
heartbeat_list_pending_items
heartbeat_complete_pending_item
web_search_duckduckgo
tools.description: Search the public web using backend /api/web/search and return normalized results.

skills.name: opfs_runtime
skills.description: OPFS context file read/write/edit runtime tools.

tools.name: opfs_read_file
tools.description: Read one OPFS fast-path context file used directly in prompt construction.

tools.name: opfs_write_file
tools.description: Write full content to OPFS context files; use for durable user/agent/process facts needed in future prompts.

tools.name: opfs_edit_file
tools.description: Edit OPFS context files (append/prepend/find-replace); preferred for frequently needed guidance (OPFS-first).

skills.name: delegation_direct_runtime
skills.description: Delegation tool surface owned by direct backend handlers.

tools.name: delegate_task
tools.description: Dispatch a delegation request via backend orchestrator.

tools.name: get_delegation_status
tools.description: Read delegation status from frontend memory/backend state.

tools.name: list_a2a_discovery_candidates
tools.description: List A2A specialist candidates by target/intent/capabilities.
